name: Kinetix AI KAI
description: A **173 cm, 70 kg** humanoid from **Kinetix AI**, which also operates as **Kai Robotics** (Shenzhen, China), unveiled on **26 April 2026**. It has **115 degrees of freedom**, **36 in each hand**, a full-body tactile skin with **18,000 sensors** and a **20 kg** lift capacity. It is aimed at retail, concierge and home assistance. Mass production is stated for later in 2026; shipping hardware has not been verified.

editorial.heading: Insights
editorial.body:
KAI is a **173 cm, 70 kg** humanoid with **115 degrees of freedom**, 36 of them in each hand, and a full-body tactile skin with **18,000 sensors**. It can lift **20 kg**. Its software is built around a **World Model** with base, action and evaluation layers. Training data is captured with **KAI Halo**, a head-mounted wearable that records first-person video and body movement from human operators.

The company was founded by veterans of the [XPeng IRON](/product-xpeng-iron) humanoid R&D team and targets retail, concierge and home assistance rather than industry. Mass production is stated for later in 2026. With no verified shipping hardware the page stays under review. No official GitHub organization was found for Kinetix AI; the humanoids table shows an em dash for "no account found", not a confirmed zero.
